summary: Getting too close to an end gateway causes the game to crash
description: The bug Going too close to the end gateway will cause the game to crash! Stack trace 1.15 Pre-release 1 : [^crash-2019-11-21_23.27.56-client.txt] Description: Rendering Block Entity java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16 at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBounds(Preconditions.java:64) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.outOfBoundsCheckIndex(Preconditions.java:70) at java.base/jdk.internal.util.Preconditions.checkIndex(Preconditions.java:248) at java.base/java.util.Objects.checkIndex(Objects.java:372) at java.base/java.util.ArrayList.get(ArrayList.java:458) at dsy.a(SourceFile:41) at dsx.a(SourceFile:30) at dsx.a(SourceFile:11) at dsk.a(SourceFile:106) at dsk.b(SourceFile:95) at dsk.a(SourceFile:127) at dsk.a(SourceFile:95) at dqm.a(SourceFile:1180) at dqi.a(SourceFile:719) at dqi.a(SourceFile:549) at dbj.d(SourceFile:941) at dbj.b(SourceFile:576) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:202)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.15 Pre-release 1.
2. Create or load a world with an End dimension.
3. Enter the End and locate an end gateway.
4. Approach the end gateway until you are within close proximity to it.
5. Observe that the game crashes when getting too close to the end gateway.
6. Take a screenshot of the crash message if possible.
7. Gather the `debug` folder, including `latest.log` and the corresponding `crash-reports/*.txt` file.
8. Note any specific coordinates or conditions under which the crash occurs.
Observed Behavior: When players get too close to an end gateway, the game crashes due to a rendering issue with the block entity. This problem occurs specifically in Minecraft version 1.15 pre-release 1 and is triggered when the player approaches within the rendering distance of the end gateway. The crash is accompanied by a stack trace indicating a `java.lang.IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 16 out of bounds for length 16`. Users have reported that attempting to re-enter their world after the initial crash results in immediate crashes upon loading, making it difficult to access or save the game without encountering this issue again. The bug affects both single-player and multiplayer environments, with several users noting that logging into a server also leads to repeated crashes due to proximity to an end gateway. To mitigate potential data loss, players are advised to make backups before testing pre-release versions of Minecraft.
Expected Behavior: When approaching an end gateway, the game should not crash and should allow the player to move freely around the structure without any issues. The block entity should render correctly, and there should be no unexpected crashes or errors when getting close to it. This behavior should be consistent across all versions of Java Edition.
